## How I checked it

- [ ] `npm run check` passes (lint, types, tests)
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e` passes, if the interface changed
- [ ] New behaviour has a test; a bug fix has the test that would have caught it
- [ ] Screenshots, if anything visible changed (light and dark)
- [ ] Docs updated, if behaviour or settings changed
